oneLine: Fairfax Financial acquires a 60.7% stake in IDBI Bank for ₹52,878 crore.

sources.title: Challenges ahead for Fairfax's management of IDBI Bank post ₹52,878 crore stake deal approval

synopsis: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved the sale of a 60.7% stake in IDBI Bank to Canada-based Fairfax Financial's subsidiary for ₹52,878 crore. The deal will bring fresh capital and new management, but faces challenges including employee resistance from the United Forum of IDBI Officers & Employees, who demanded suspension of the sale. The new management will need to transform the public-sector legacy into an agile private-sector entity while improving asset quality, as IDBI Bank's gross non-performing asset ratio of 2.3% in FY26 remains higher than private peers despite strong profitability metrics like a 2.3% Return on Assets and 3.8% Net Interest Margin.
